description: The schema-to-pojo project was started because we wanted to programmatically generate the Plain Old Java Objects (POJOs) from JSON schemas.  More specifically we wanted to use the generated POJOs as resources of the Synapse JSON REST web services API. Since we are using the POJOs as REST resources we also wanted an easy way to marsh instances to/from JSON.
